verdict.rationale: Weave offers in-product AI-driven analysis of your data. Built-in and custom signals automatically classify agent interactions and surface failure modes, and LLM-judge and predefined scorers (hallucination, summarization quality) produce AI-generated assessments of traces. However, nothing in the evidence shows a native in-product assistant that generates insights or suggests improvements. The conversational, suggestion-style experience is delivered by external coding agents through the MCP server and Skills, not inside the Weave UI. Missing for 10: an in-product AI assistant or chat over your data, AI-generated improvement suggestions inside the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration that signals produce useful insights.
